title: Passive melee auto-attack-speed bindings are validated only by white admission and silently discarded otherwise

evidence.note: uncompiled effect / Enemy actor / duplicate Player binding all accepted without a main hand; raw-193 uncompiled binding -> MissingPassiveHasteAllDefinition

evidence.ref: no other consumer of raw-319 exists, so the accepted state is behaviourally identical; the defect is a fail-open input boundary, not a wrong executable value

why_tests_missed: raw-319 tests (engine/tests/selected_melee_auto_attack_speed.rs, program/passive_melee_auto_attack_speed/tests) always pair the binding with an admitted main hand; negative binding tests exercise only white isolation
correction_boundary: state construction: validate PassiveMeleeSpeedBinding (compiled definition exists, Player actor, no duplicates) independently of the main hand, as prepare_actor_topology does for PassiveHasteAllBinding, or reject melee-speed bindings when no main hand consumes them
must_not_widen: do not give raw-319 a consumer outside the isolated main hand; do not relax white isolation (exact [Player binding]); do not fold into the 5-family package-binding iterator unless raw-319 becomes a package member there
